doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02

title: How De De and Billie got the job at Lutcher's
summary: Billie explains how Melvin Frank hired them at Luthjen's, Edna Francis filled in for her piano, and De De took over the band and hired his wife.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: In fact, Smiley worked there before I did at Lutches. Years back, years ahead of me. I remember him being there too one time. See, after that, what's this boy, Melvin Frank, I don't know if he's still living?
Wait, let me tell you now how everything happened.

You see, I don't know what the humbug they had, Miss Miley and Lawrence Down at Lutches, that was the first beginning before I even started to go working for them. See, so I don't know, they couldn't get along with some another damn day, see. And the fellow Melvin Frank, he's dead. So Melvin Frank, come and hired me and Dede, come down there to work, see. Yes. And we go down there to work. Well, Edna Francis was living a piano player. Well, that's when my sister left to go away. I guess on the boat, we'll take the job on the boat and put Edna Francis in my place to work down there with my husband, you see. Yes. Down at Lutches. Well, when I get off the boat on a Sunday evening, I would go down there Sunday night and meet some sitting down there, just have my fun rhythm right on like that, you see. Well, alright, so. Then Melvin, he the one had the job in charge. Well, Melvin used to go there, he's not really afraid of losing his mind or something like that, see. He'd get the two in his arms coming up like that, so an old man knows what's the problem, an old man just turn the work over to Dede, see.
And that's why he was little down and looking to work him.
Yeah, if I take the job over, so. And then from then I hired Willie to go with me, to work with me, being my wife, you see. Yeah.
